review.finding: write_decision_log.py has no sys.path bootstrap for its lazy `from lib....` imports, unlike every sibling tool. The new unconditional `from lib.decision_log_index import refresh_best_effort` import (previously only the conditional `--architecture-impact` path needed a `lib.` import) means a plain `append_decision()` call now raises ModuleNotFoundError when invoked as a bare CLI with no PYTHONPATH set — the exact invocation shape plan/build/deploy use.
review.suggestion: Add the same `_SCRIPTS_ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]; sys.path.insert(0, str(_SCRIPTS_ROOT))` bootstrap every other shared/scripts/tools/*.py CLI already carries, and add a regression test that runs the CLI with PYTHONPATH unset.
